distributor.name: Msunduzi Local Municipality Electricity Unit
distributor.notes: Pietermaritzburg. 2026/27 Register of Tariffs and Charges exists (msunduzi.gov.za / marrc.org.za) but line-item rates were not machine-readable this session. Historical register figures are unreliable as a base: NERSA approved 13.32% for 2025/26 (not the drafted schedule), and a Jan 2026 High Court ruling ordered NERSA to re-determine Msunduzi's disputed 2024/25 tariffs.

approved_increase.notes: Council approved 29 May 2026; in effect 1 July 2026. Recheck 2026-07-05: The Witness (26 June 2026) confirms NERSA 'considered its submission and subsequently approved its electricity tariffs' — 9.26% retail vs the 8.76% Eskom bulk increase to Msunduzi, via a cost-plus infrastructure markup; the local Chamber of Business disputes the cost-of-supply methodology.
